item.title: Lawyers in the Library — Wed Aug 5, 5:00 PM — Sonoma Valley Regional Library
item.description: Local volunteer attorneys offer free legal information and referral for general law matters. These lawyer consultations will last up to 20 minutes. Sign-ups are first come, first served in person and begin at 4:30 pm. \(30 minutes before the program begins\) --- The attorneys are volunteers and provide only legal information. They do not provide specific legal advice and should not be considered as personal lawyers for any reason. You will be required to sign a waiver before speaking to an attorney that states that no attorney-client relationship is being created with this free service. No language translation services or interpreters are offered or provided by library staff. Participants must bring their own interpreter if one is needed. Participants may also bring support persons, family members or other affiliated persons to meet with the attorney together. item.title: Library Commission Regular Meeting — Wed Aug 5, 6:00 PM — Sonoma County Library Headquarters
item.description:
Sonoma County Library Headquarters will host the Regular Library Commission meeting. The Sonoma County Library Commission is an 11-person body responsible for governing the library. Commissioners are appointed by the cities in Sonoma County and the county Board of Supervisors. The commission establishes policy; sets goals and objectives; hires and evaluates the director; establishes and monitors the annual budget; and exercises such other powers, consistent with the law to foster the effective use and management of the library. The commission generally meets monthly, with additional special meetings as needed. Meetings are open to the public and recordings are accessible online through
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:
Bring your instrument, your voice, and join us for a fun evening of music, comedy, and spoken word.
The Host is Randy Foisy, a talented rhythm guitarist and vocalist with an extensive repertoire of covers from the 60's, 70's, 80's, 90's and beyond, and is also a popular singer/songwriter.
"Randy's Ear Candy " is his weekly radio show streaming on KSVY.org, and live at 91.3 FM, Saturdays 5:00p-7:00p, with rock n' roll deep cuts, reggae, and jam bands.
Randy has been hosting Open Mics in Calistoga for over 30 years and is excited to host an Open Mic in Sonoma.

item.title: Josh Flores: Big Feels - Featured August Artist in the Living Room — Fri Aug 7, 9:00 AM — San Geronimo Valley Community Center
item.description:
The San Geronimo Valley Community Center proudly presents the artwork of **Josh Flores** in the Living Room of the Maurice Del Mue Galleries. There will be a reception for the artist on **August 9 from 2 - 4 pm**.
Josh has previously exhibited work in the San Rafael Youth In Arts Program “What About Age?” exhibit at the Marin Civic Center and the “One If By Land, Two if By Sea” show at the Bolinas Art Museum. This is Josh’s first solo exhibition at the Community Center.
**Artist bio:** Josh Flores was born in Lima, Peru and raised in Marin. He appreciates the experience of taking a blank piece of paper and going through the process of making something as a reminder to himself that he is capable of anything. His earliest influence to make art came from watching amateur anime, reading manga and his first art teacher Mr. Powell.

item.title: Live Music Friday: Joyce Grant & Company — Fri Aug 7, 6:00 PM — Coal Shed Brewery
item.description: Joyce Grant singer/songwriter is the great-great-niece of famed ragtime composer Scott Joplin and has written lyrics to four of his songs. She has participated in the West Coast Ragtime Festival for several years. City Swing started a new chapter in 2007 with jazz singer Joyce Grant. She is the lead vocalist for City Swing, an 18 piece big band. Grant has been singing jazz in Bay Area venues for over 20 years. A mezzo-soprano with a voice like dark honey, Grant has a performance resume which includes a wide range of venues including the Empire Plush Room and Zingari Ristaurante in San Francisco, the Ledson Hotel in Sonoma, Sam's Chowder House & Cetrella in Half Moon Bay, the Sticky Rice in Fairfield, Carneros in Napa, Slates in Walnut Creek, Joe’s of Lafayette, and the Woodminster Amphitheater just to name a few. item.description:
Bring your instrument, your voice, and join us for a fun evening of music, comedy, and spoken word.
The Host is Randy Foisy, a talented rhythm guitarist and vocalist with an extensive repertoire of covers from the 60's, 70's, 80's, 90's and beyond, and is also a popular singer/songwriter.
"Randy's Ear Candy " is his weekly radio show streaming on KSVY.org, and live at 91.3 FM, Saturdays 5:00p-7:00p, with rock n' roll deep cuts, reggae, and jam bands.
Randy has been hosting Open Mics in Calistoga for over 30 years and is excited to host an Open Mic in Sonoma.

item.title: Josh Flores: Big Feels - Featured August Artist in the Living Room — Fri Aug 14, 9:00 AM — San Geronimo Valley Community Center
item.description:
The San Geronimo Valley Community Center proudly presents the artwork of **Josh Flores** in the Living Room of the Maurice Del Mue Galleries. There will be a reception for the artist on **August 9 from 2 - 4 pm**.
Josh has previously exhibited work in the San Rafael Youth In Arts Program “What About Age?” exhibit at the Marin Civic Center and the “One If By Land, Two if By Sea” show at the Bolinas Art Museum. This is Josh’s first solo exhibition at the Community Center.
**Artist bio:** Josh Flores was born in Lima, Peru and raised in Marin. He appreciates the experience of taking a blank piece of paper and going through the process of making something as a reminder to himself that he is capable of anything. His earliest influence to make art came from watching amateur anime, reading manga and his first art teacher Mr. Powell.

item.description:

SCHEDULE:
1:00-1:15: Introductions
1:15-2:15: Write in silence for 1 hour
2:15-2:30: Check-ins: how did it go?
Details: \- Parking: This location has a parking lot\.
\- Patronage: Please thank our hosts by purchasing something\.

\- Noise: Some writers use headphones or earplugs to block ambient noise\.
